description: 6 exemplars (one German) + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-25 under road-to-closing-the-gaps-a-comparison-named 2.1, which added this judge's behavioural evals and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars are diffs to review on this judge's axis; near-misses are the sibling judges and the neighbouring do-the-work commands; counterexamples guard the everyday sense of the axis word. Not yet run, so it carries no last_eval.

queries.q: does this diff have tests for every new branch?
this bug fix has no regression test — judge the coverage
are these tests asserting anything or just running code?
check whether the PR over-mocks the repository
judge the test coverage of the changed files
write the missing tests for this service
queries.note: tests:create writes tests; this judge assesses them

queries.q: review this diff for off-by-one errors
why is this test flaky on CI?
queries.note: debugging a red test is not a coverage review

queries.q: how do I prepare for my driving test next week?
what coverage does my car insurance include?
